top_signals.title: US Stocks Waver on Nvidia Selloff as Oil Rallies: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A leadership crisis at Nvidia Corp. curbed the appetite for riskier corners on Wall Street, with stocks also wavering as a rally in oil prices lifted Treasury yields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
top_signals.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Why Nordstrom Decided to Go Private
top_signals.summary: Nordstrom Co-CEO Pete Nordstrom, says that there is "a lot of headroom" in the firm's Rack concept and that he and his brother, Co-CEO Erik Nordstrom, wanted more influence over some of the company's decisions in explaining why they took Nordstrom private in 2025. He speaks with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)
